Add this table to your player

Add this page’s public URL to your BMS/PMS player’s difficulty-table settings, then refresh the table. This page exposes the standard bmstable header and chart hashes.

Use the package and chart links to obtain the playable files. This site hosts metadata only. Browser filters help you browse; player imports contain the entire Lv 1–45+ collection. Five-button entries use PMS format.

PMS ratings and download credits: PMS Database normal table. mopemope Lv22 and Lv40 use ratings retained in the excluded table (BGA gore category). Cutter 3? and 11? are provisional ratings from hash-verified BOFXVI files, added after the local database audit; they are not normalized upstream ratings.

Japanese song catalogs: maimai · CHUNITHM · ONGEKI. Discovery cross-checks: BMSまとめ · ONGEKI BMS list. Source and selection notes.

Independent fan table; not affiliated with SEGA or the source maintainers. Japanese-series presence is checked, not availability in every region. This is the overlap found in the reviewed sources, not a claim that every existing PMS chart is listed.
